title: Maxwell's 'A Dynamical Theory of the Electromagnetic Field' (1865)
summary: On 16 June 1865 James Clerk Maxwell's paper 'A dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field' was sent to the printers Taylor and Francis for publication in the Philosophical Transactions. A 2015 commentary in the same journal calls it his great paper, which established his dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field. MacTutor notes that he left King's College London in the spring of 1865 and returned to his Scottish estate Glenlair.

uncertainty.note: Date of sending to the printers is given exactly as 16 June 1865 in the commentary. The Royal Society scan's date is recorded in the commentary as incorrect (1 January 1865) and is not used.

importance.justification: The 2015 Philosophical Transactions commentary calls the 1865 paper Maxwell's great paper and says it established his dynamical theory of the electromagnetic field, the foundation of classical electromagnetism. The commentary is the only source opened for the score, and it is a single expert appraisal.
